**Morgan Latif is a specialist leadership search & development consultancy. We partner with clients across the Medical & Dental Technology, Packaging, Consumer, E-mobility, and Industrial Technology sectors to support their transformation and diversity objectives.
Our mission is to combine traditional recruitment and coaching methodologies with innovative technology to deliver tailored solutions to both clients and candidates.**
**Position Overview**
A well-established precision manufacturing organisation is seeking a Manufacturing Director to lead and transform shop floor operations within a complex, high-mix, regulated manufacturing environment.
This role is a critical leadership hire, with responsibility for driving operational excellence across machining and assembly operations, embedding structured problem-solving, and implementing KPI-led daily management systems.
The Manufacturing Director will be accountable for professionalising shop floor operations, shifting the culture from reactive firefighting to data-driven, continuous improvement, and building the leadership capability required to sustain long-term performance.
This position requires a hands-on, visible leader with deep Lean expertise, strong emotional intelligence, and the ability to influence at all levels—from shop floor operators to executive leadership.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the transformation of manufacturing operations through standardisation, Lean methodologies, and continuous improvement
* Establish and sustain daily management systems aligned to SQDP (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Productivity)
* Drive a structured problem-solving culture, enabling teams to resolve issues quickly using data-driven approaches
* Improve operational performance across key metrics including OTD, productivity, quality, and labor/machine efficiency
* Coach teams to think in end-to-end value streams (SIPOC) and understand broader operational impact
* Partner cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Quality, and EHS to drive aligned outcomes
* Support the development and optimisation of leading KPI frameworks in collaboration with senior leadership
* Drive cultural change toward accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement
* Lead organisational design and restructuring initiatives where required to optimise performance
* Build and lead a high-performing manufacturing leadership team
* Develop Production Managers to adopt a problem-solving, people-centric leadership style
* Foster a culture of ownership, engagement, and continuous improvement across the shop floor
**Qualifications & Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related field
* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing operations
* Proven experience in complex, regulated manufacturing environments (medical device, aerospace/defense preferred)
* Demonstrated success leading operational transformation and cultural change initiatives
* Deep expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies
* Strong understanding of OEE, cycle times, throughput, and production flow optimisation
* Experience implementing KPI-driven daily management systems
* Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management capability
* Experience in machining or precision manufacturing environments is highly desirable
* US Citizen or Green Card holder only
We look forward to your application!

capture.text:
Grand Prix Plaza, home of the Formula 1 Heineken Las Vegas Grand Prix, is a world-class entertainment and event destination spanning approximately 39 acres in the heart of the Las Vegas Grand Prix circuit.  The 300,000-square-foot facility features immersive Formula 1 attractions, premium hospitality experiences, event and meeting venues, retail, food and beverage offerings, and year-round activations that attract guests from across the globe.  As both a daily operating entertainment venue and a critical component of one of the world's most recognized sporting events, Grand Prix Plaza requires a high-performing operational structure capable of delivering exceptional experiences while maintaining the highest standards of safety, service, and facility excellence.


 POSITION OVERVIEW
 The Director of Production serves as the leader responsible for all the experiences and production operations across Grand Prix Plaza.  This position provides strategic leadership for Production, Guest Experience, Box Office, and Karting operations, ensuring all attractions, technical systems, guest interactions, and show elements consistently deliver a premium and memorable experience.
 
Working closely with the General Manager and cross-functional departments, the Director of Production drives operational strategy, financial performance, workforce development, guest satisfaction, and continuous innovation across the venue's immersive attractions and entertainment offerings.  This role is responsible for ensuring all production and guest experience elements remain operationally ready to support daily business, private events, seasonal activations, and the Formula 1 Heineken Las Vegas Grand Prix.


 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Develop and execute operational strategies that support organizational goals, business growth, and long-term venue objectives. 
 Provides overall leadership and direction for Production, Guest Experience, Box Office, and Karting departments.
 Leads, develops, and mentors departmental leadership teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, safety, and continuous improvement. 
 Establishes operational standards, guest service expectations, performance metrics, and departmental goals to drive exceptional guest satisfaction and revenue performance. 
 Oversees annual operating budgets, capital planning, labor strategies, and financial performance for all production and guest-facing departments. 
 Directs the planning, integration, and execution of attraction enhancements, technical upgrades, new experiences, venue activations, and special events. 
 Provides executive oversight of attraction reliability, show quality, technical systems, and operational readiness across all guest-facing experiences. 
 Manages key vendor relationships, production partners, service providers, and equipment suppliers to ensure performance, quality, and financial objectives are achieved. 
 Partners with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to support venue-wide initiatives, operational readiness, and organizational goals. 
 Ensures compliance with all applicable safety standards, operational procedures, regulatory requirements, and risk management practices associated with attractions, entertainment, and guest operations.
 Other responsibilities as assigned
 

 QUALIFICATIONS 
 9+ years of progressive leadership experience within entertainment venues, attractions, theme parks, sports venues, immersive experiences, or hospitality operations. 
 Demonstrated experience leading multi-disciplinary teams across production, guest experience, attractions, entertainment, box office, or related operational functions. 
 Proven experience managing operating budgets, labor planning, capital expenditures, and departmental financial performance. 
 Strong knowledge of attraction operations, live entertainment production, technical systems, guest experience management, and venue operations. 
 Experience overseeing third-party vendors, production contractors, service providers, and strategic partnerships. 
 Knowledge of OSHA requirements, risk management practices, life safety standards, and operational compliance requirements. 
 Experience supporting large-scale events, attraction launches, venue activations, or public-facing entertainment operations. 
 Strong business knowledge with the ability to analyze operational metrics, guest feedback, revenue performance, and financial reporting. 
 Exceptional leadership, communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills. 
 Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
   
 WORK SCHEDULE: 
 This is a full-time position that works a flexible schedule including weekdays, weekends, evenings, and holidays.   
  
 SEASONAL & EVENT-BASED RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 This role includes a seasonal period during which responsibilities extend beyond standard operations.  During load-in and load-out of the Grand Prix Plaza facility, race week activations, and other special projects, this position may support non-traditional functions that fall outside a routine.  Flexibility, cross-functional collaboration, and adaptability are essential and required during these high-impact times.
  
 PHYSICAL DEMANDS 
 Physical ability to walk, stand, take stairs/elevators/escalators, and navigate the elements during the day and night
